metadata.title: WebRTC DataChannel Reference Protocol Matrix
metadata.description: Matrix of all DataChannels negotiated between Browser WebUI and cloudphone-agent, extracted from useWebRTC.js

channels.label: input-channel
channels.framing: Binary control packet protocol (event_type: touch, keycode, scroll, text injection)
channels.open_close_behavior: Created by agent upon P2P connection establishment; closed on WebRTC teardown
channels.fallback_mechanism: Signaling WebSocket fallback via message_type: 'inject_data' (channel='input') or group_control_event

channels.label: clipboard-channel
channels.framing: JSON formatted string encoded as UTF-8 ArrayBuffer

message_fields.origin_client_id: string or null (prevents clipboard synchronization loops)

channels.open_close_behavior: Created by agent; dispatches onmessage to clipboardCallback; closed on teardown

channels.label: camera-channel
channels.message_direction: Bi-directional (Agent sends control commands; Browser sends camera video feed frames)
channels.framing: JSON control messages for handshake; binary raw video frames for streaming
channels.open_close_behavior: Created by agent when device camera HAL injection is available; stops stream on close
channels.fallback_mechanism: None (camera virtualization requires high-bandwidth P2P DataChannel)

channels.label: file-channel
channels.message_direction: Bi-directional (Browser sends upload chunks; Agent confirms/sends file data)
channels.framing: Binary chunk framing: [header_length (4B)] + [JSON metadata] + [raw binary chunk payload]
channels.open_close_behavior: Pre-created by browser during PeerConnection setup prior to SDP offer processing
channels.fallback_mechanism: HTTP REST fallback via multipart/form-data POST /upload

channels.label: ai-command-channel
channels.message_direction: Bi-directional (Browser sends request; Agent returns response)
channels.framing: JSON string encoded as UTF-8 ArrayBuffer

message_fields.request_id: string (unique random request identifier for async matching)
message_fields.command: string (shell command text or AI action)

channels.open_close_behavior: Created dynamically on-demand by browser when command execution is requested
channels.fallback_mechanism: Signaling WebSocket fallback via message_type: 'command' with identical request_id

channels.label: adb-channel
channels.framing: Raw ADB transport protocol packets (CNXN, OPEN, OKAY, CLSE, WRTE)
channels.open_close_behavior: Created by browser when user opens WebADB terminal console in WebUI
channels.fallback_mechanism: WebSocket stream tunnel fallback or local USB ADB
